messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — prod-streaming-usw2 cluster: decode p99 spike detected. Route /v1/generate-stream p99 jumped from 3.8s to 12.4s in last 15m. SLO breach (p99 > 10s).

alex (oncall): paging myself. seeing big tail on streaming sessions, mostly cold-starts + decode stalls. Will collect pod-level metrics.

maria (runtime): i'm looking at decode pods now — lots of pagefaults on decoder kernel logs and repeated GPU memcpy stalls. Could be the kernel bits we rolled yesterday (trt8/flashattn kernel package).

alex (oncall): timeline: we rolled runtime-kernel:v2026-03-14-trt8 at ~23:05 UTC. first anomalies at ~23:20. Rolling avg p95 also up but p99 is worst.

jordan (infra): grabbing node metrics. disk cache miss rate on these pods is high; some nodes show small swap activity (we shouldn't be swapping). Also seeing increased __memcpy_sync latency in dmesg.

alex (oncall): ok can someone grab a sample stack/log snippet from a stalled decoder pod? paste here.

maria (runtime): pasted sample below:

```
[decoder] decode_step: seq=1523 waiting on kernel memcpy (cudaMemcpyAsync)
[decoder] nvprof: kernel memcpy queued but stalled for 270ms
[decoder] pagefault: vmalloc or compilepath eviction for kv-cache
[trace] compilepath loaded kernel trt_fused_flashattn_v2
```

maria (runtime): looks like the new fused flashattn kernel path is getting cold cache thrash on first few tokens for streaming sessions. KV cache misses + larger kernel working set = paging to host memory.

alex (oncall): customer-impact: we have elevated error/retry from top 10 tenants, CS flagged ACME-Ads (ticket #12345) reporting streaming stalls / user-visible slow downs. Not yet 1:1 outage but SLO alerts firing.

customer-success: ACME-Ads says ~5% of live sessions saw stalls >10s, mostly weekdays peak. They're asking for ETA.

alex (oncall): initial mitigation options: 1) roll back kernel to previous build on canary nodes, 2) pin model variant with smaller fused kernels, 3) enable aggressive prewarm/prefill KV cache for streaming, 4) scale replicas to absorb cold starts.

jordan (infra): i can scale replicas quickly and do a targeted canary rollback. prefer to do canary rollback first to validate.

maria (runtime): agree. I'll prepare a canary rollback manifest to runtime-kernel:v2026-03-10 which didn't show this behavior. Canary on 4 nodes in us-west-2a, route 5% traffic.

alex (oncall): please post commands you will run. I'll coordinate traffic routing and monitor p95/p99.

maria (runtime): running:
```
kubectl -n prod set image ds/runtime-kernel runtime-kernel=redwood/runtime-kernel:v2026-03-10 --record
kubectl rollout status daemonset/runtime-kernel -n prod
# then restart a subset of decoder pods in us-west-2a
kubectl rollout restart deploy/decoder --namespace=prod -l zone=us-west-2a --grace-period=30
```

sre-automation-bot: started canary rollback job 3821. Canary nodes: prod-usw2a-nd-10..13. Routing rule updated: 5% traffic -> canary nodes.

alex (oncall): scaled decoder replicas 30 -> 60 in us-west-2 to reduce cold-start amplification. command: `kubectl scale deploy/decoder --replicas=60 -n prod` :white_check_mark:

maria (runtime): monitoring canary now. initial p99 on canary (post-rollback) = 2.1s, p95 = 0.45s. Prod non-canary still at p99 ~11.6s.

alex (oncall): good signal. if canary stays healthy for 10m, start broader rollback. notify sales/CS with ETA.

customer-success: told ACME-Ads we're actively mitigating and expect improvement in ~15-25 minutes.

jordan (infra): observed kernel dmesg on canary nodes shows no memcpy stalls post-rollback, pagefault rate dropped ~80%.

maria (runtime): note: this points to an interaction between the new fused flashattn kernel and host memory/kv-cache layout on cold streaming sessions. we'll keep an RCA in next 24h. For now, roll forward/rollback plan: if canary stays stable 15m -> promote rollback cluster-wide.

alex (oncall): escalation check: we should consider a short customer-facing incident page if primary tenants continue to see >5% impact after full rollback. For now CS is handling top customers.

ops-shift-lead: preparing postmortem template. assign owners: runtime kernel investigation -> maria, infra node/kernel tracing -> jordan, customer comms -> customer-success.

sre-automation-bot: canary observed p99 improvement sustained for 12m. Initiating staged rollback to remaining us-west-2 nodes with 5m intervals between groups.

maria (runtime): executed staged rollout. after group 2 rollback, global p99 dropped to 2.4s, streaming error rate down 70%.

alex (oncall): keep monitoring dashboards: streaming p95/p99, pod pagefaults, node dmesg. Also run a synthetic load to validate cold-start paths: `python perf/synthetic_stream_test.py --hosts prod-usw2 --concurrency 200 --seed=kv_prefill_off`.

jordan (infra): synthetic looks clean on rolled-back nodes. failing pods are only on nodes awaiting rollback.

maria (runtime): we will block the bad kernel from future autopromote in the build pipeline and add an automated e2e cold-start streaming test to catch this. filing infra ticket: TKT-8421.

alex (oncall): handoff to night oncall @jordan at shift change in 20m. if any regression after rollback or new kernel fixes are proposed, raise in #eng-runtime.

jordan (infra): taking handoff. summary: root suspected: trt8/flashattn fused kernel working set + kv-cache layout -> cold cache paging -> decode memcpy stalls -> p99 tail. Mitigation: canary rollback -> staged rollback -> scale replicas. Current state: all us-west-2 rolled back, global p99 normalized ~2.2s, CS notified, owners assigned.

ops-shift-lead: thanks team. filing incident record and follow ups (postmortem, timeline, build-block) — will update ticket and schedule RCA meeting tomorrow. :thumbsup:
